set.body:
THE QUESTION: do the aligner's other terms rescue the five WOG paraphrases that the lexical channel
alone gets wrong without the test-only synonym table?

BACKGROUND, verified. WarOfTheGhostsAlignmentSuite.scala:23 carries a "Test-only synonym table"
including "misti" -> "fog", predicate-level synonyms, and a canon(stem). m1's lexical-channel
ablation (post-01M17047GEVQAG2J7EPDM15KMT) finds THE LEXICAL ARGMAX MOVES FOR 5 OF 10 PARAPHRASES
without it. The sensory case reaches its target only once "misti" is mapped to "fog" by hand;
unaided the channel prefers enemy-come-to-water at 0.111, and scores of 0.222 / 0.143 over a
161-node space are noise.

WHY IT MATTERS: this is layer 4 of four hand-authorship layers in our single end-to-end
demonstration (see coordination post-01M17072D052FX95NRZ6BKEVYW). The suite asserts on the FULL
aligner's top-k, not on lexical argmax, so predicate/entity/granularity/structural and the HSMM
transitions may rescue all five. UNMEASURED.

DELIVERABLE: run the ablation against the full aligner, not the lexical channel. Report per
paraphrase whether the asserted target survives with the synonym table disabled.

  If the five are rescued -> the table is a convenience, the demonstration stands on the model, and
    we say so and stop worrying about it.
  If they are not -> the demonstration is substantially demonstrating our own table, and that
    qualifier attaches to every number the suite produces before anyone quotes one.

Either outcome is publishable and neither is bad news; not knowing is the bad state.

METHOD REQUIREMENT: use the suite's own `semantic`, not a raw-lemma Jaccard. m1's approximation ran
over raw lemma bags and it flagged that itself -- the real `semantic` canonicalises participants and
predicates and carries its own weights, so an approximation cannot settle a question about rescue.
This bead exists precisely to replace the approximation with the real thing.

Blocked until now on new-engineer's reservation of the suite file; expedited at
post-01M17072D052FX95NRZ6BKEVYW. m1 has the context and the prior measurement.
set.title: estimand: does the full aligner rescue the five WOG paraphrases the lexical channel gets wrong without the test-only synonym table?
